anomalies.observed: R33 (10k) is a pull-up from the gate node /NET0092 to +3V3, not to GND. This gate node is the main-pump FET T7 (IRLR2905) gate. The equivalent ATO-valve stage uses R11 (10k) from its gate net /NET0015 to GND. The gate of T7 therefore defaults to on.
anomalies.expected: A low-side N-FET gate that is pre-driven by a BT3904 inverter should be pulled down to GND so the pump is off by default. The FLOAT_LOW interlock (IO0 via R8 to T8 base) should switch the pump off when the low-level float trips.
anomalies.impact: The main pump's gate is held high through 10k, so T7 conducts at power-up and whenever IO10 and IO0 are not driving it low. The main pump can run unattended. When the low-level float opens T8, the gate is pulled up rather than down, so the dry-run protection fails.

anomalies.observed: The EN pin of the TPS62933 buck regulator U5 (pin 2) is marked no-connect and has no net. Its enable is therefore left floating.
anomalies.expected: The enable pin of a buck regulator should be tied to VIN or driven by a defined level so the regulator's on/off state is not left to chance.
anomalies.impact: The 24 V to 5 V buck may not enable reliably. This could leave the +5V rail, the ESP32 and the 3.3 V LDO unpowered or in an undefined state.
